items.difficulty_reason: 24 行、Koszul 正交性（Bokstedt-Neeman 的模拟离散版）：①锥三角 E → Rj_*E|_U → N；K|_U=0 + 伴随性 ⇒ Hom(K[n], Rj_*E|_U)=0 ⇒ 只需对 N（即 E|_U=0）证明；②Koszul 乘法三角（more-algebra）把 Hom 消失从 K 传到所有幂 K_e；③represent-cohomology-class-on-closed 引理：支撑在闭补上的对象的上同调类由 K_e 表示 ⇒ RΓ(X,E)=0；④affine-compare ⇒ E=0，(1)⟺(2) 拿到。承重全在 span 内；4 处引用（2 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-orthogonal-koszul-complex (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 4070-4083

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the cone triangle of the map to the pushforward, the vanishing of Hom out of the Koszul complex into the pushforward by adjunction and the vanishing of the Koszul restriction, the multiplicativity triangles of Koszul complexes extending the vanishing to all powers, and the closed-support representation lemma together with the affine comparison concluding E equals its pushforward (source lines 4085-4108)
